newsitem.title: SPAIN: GOLF-JAMES TAKES EARLY LEAD IN MADRID OPEN.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-JAMES TAKES EARLY LEAD IN MADRID OPEN.

text.p: Veteran Ryder Cup player Mark James of England birdied three of the last five holes to take the lead early in the second round of the Spanish Open on Friday.
James, 43, who has appeared in seven Ryder Cups, posted a four-under-par 68 to move to nine-under 135, two shots clear of Denmark's Thomas Bjorn.
Bjorn, who looks likely to earn his first Ryder Cup place, carded 69 to head joint overnight leader Alex Cejka of Germany by two strokes.
Cejka's partner at the top of the leaderboard on Thursday, Ireland's defending champion Padraig Harrington, lost a ball on the 11th to slip to a 76 and 142.
